extracted.intended_audience: writers and authors (self-published and submitting) seeking professional editorial and sensitivity-reading services
extracted.subtask_description: Service and quality guidelines for a commercial editing house describing what each edit type includes, pricing, deliverables, formatting requirements, turnaround, and special-case services (sensitivity reads, screenplays, games, illustrations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Consult and exact quote policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Expect an exact quote after consulting with your chosen editor. Free consults for the first 1,000 words are offered for anything above 10,000 words. All consults will be charged a minimum of $240/service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Request a consult via form or email hello@saltandsagebooks.com. Invoices sent through Stripe; PayPal also available. Payment plans offered on request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum turnaround and rush policy
rubrics_metrics.description: All edits will take a minimum of 4 weeks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rush edits are available case-by-case for an additional fee. There is a 10-day minimum for rush edits over 100k words.

rubrics_metrics.name: File format and formatting requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Please send all of your documents in .docx or Google Docs, 12 pt Times New Roman, 1" margins.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript length splitting
rubrics_metrics.description: If your piece is longer than 130,000 words, it will be split into two separate bookings to facilitate editorial turnaround.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of style guide
rubrics_metrics.description: We use the Chicago Manual of Style.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may add a deluxe style guide for an extra fee (see line-edit entry).

rubrics_metrics.name: Sensitivity reads — baseline
rubrics_metrics.description: To honor the emotional labor required for a sensitivity read, pricing begins at $240. From $0.024c (or $240 per 10,000 words). This is for a single pass and one round of follow-up questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sensitivity reads help when writing outside lived experience or expertise and are available for outlines, story ideas, blurbs, pitches, character sketches, illustrations, poetry, marketing, academic writing, video games, TTRPG content, finished manuscripts, etc. Tell us exactly what feedback you need from a specific reader.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cultural Consultation
rubrics_metrics.description: Book a trio of questions & answers via email or a one-hour video call for $240 flat rate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed as a focused Q&A with a sensitivity/expert reader.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial Sensitivity Read (combined)
rubrics_metrics.description: Editorial Sensitivity Read (light developmental edit + sensitivity read): prices from $490. From $0.049c (or $490 per 10,000 words). This is for a single pass of a light dev edit + sensitivity read and one round of follow-up questions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purchase when you want a highly qualified editor to read for story and sensitivity; highly customizable — client can specify exactly the sort of feedback they need. If combining with other edits, request a quote.

rubrics_metrics.name: Line editing (scope and pricing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Line editing (no style sheet) beginning at $300. From $0.03c/word (or $300 per 10,000 words).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Line editing focuses on word choice and usage, repetition, sentence flow, paragraph/sentence length, some fact checking. If you want to smooth out prose or tighten word count, you want a line edit. Add a deluxe style guide for an extra $100 per 10,000 words (0.04c/word).

rubrics_metrics.name: Proofreading / Copy edit (scope and pricing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proofreading aka “Copy Edit” from 0.025c/word (or $250 per 10,000 words).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A proofread is an edit of punctuation, spelling, capitalization, verb tenses, and grammar. Note: this is not the same as a line edit. If you would like to combine your line edit and proofread, request a combined price (priced at 0.055c/word or $550 per 10,000 words).

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation check
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Available languages: French, Spanish, and Brazilian Portuguese.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developmental editing tiers and deliverables
rubrics_metrics.description: Developmental edits are the first step in publishing with multiple tiers: Reader Report, Light Developmental Edit, Deep Developmental Edit, Deluxe Developmental Edit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reader Report: From 0.0125c/word ($125 per 10,000 words). Author gets an editor’s letter. Light Dev Edit: From 0.025c/word; focuses on five essential keys (world building, plot holes, pacing, character arcs, emotional authenticity & resonance); author receives in-text comments plus an editor’s letter. Deep Dev Edit: From 0.05c/word; deep dive focusing on eight critical areas; many in-text comments plus detailed editor’s letter. Deluxe Dev Edit: From 0.1c/word; paired with top-level editor, deeper work on eight critical areas, deep in-text comments, extremely detailed editor’s letter, plus choice of 3 follow-up options (30-minute video chat; follow-up passes of sections up to 10,000 words; clarifying questions via email) and includes one 30-minute “emergency” video chat. Limited slots; book in advance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Light developmental edit focus areas (five essential keys)
rubrics_metrics.description: Light Developmental edit focuses on five essential keys of storytelling and writing: world building, plot holes, pacing, character arcs, and emotional authenticity & resonance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is highly customizable and returns in-text comments plus an editor’s letter. Priced from 0.025c/word.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deep/Deluxe developmental edit focus areas (eight critical areas)
rubrics_metrics.description: Deep and Deluxe developmental edits focus on eight critical areas that will make storytelling and writing stronger (page references to 'eight critical areas' used by the provider).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Deep edit provides many in-text comments plus a detailed editor’s letter (from 0.05c/word). Deluxe goes deeper with highest-level editors and adds follow-ups and emergency chat (from 0.1c/word).

rubrics_metrics.name: Beta reads (purpose and deliverable)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A great final step to ensure your piece is meeting audience’s genre expectations. Author receives an editor’s letter with general impressions and feedback on genre accuracy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query and first-chapter services
rubrics_metrics.description: Query edit: Have a querying expert go over your query three times until it’s perfect — $240 flat fee. First chapter edit: From $240 up to 4,000 words (can be developmental, line, or proofread — specify preference). Blurb edit: $240 flat fee, with up to three rounds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Query/first-chapter/blurb edits are positioned as targeted, iterative services to polish submission/marketing materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graphic novels, comics, illustrations, and video game editing
rubrics_metrics.description: Illustrations charged at $25/page with a minimum fee of $250; video game play-throughs charged hourly at $240 with a minimum fee of $240 that increases in 10-minute increments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Illustration fee includes a detailed editor’s letter. Video game play-through includes a post-viewing editor’s letter. Recommend hiring sensitivity readers for visual projects at the pencil stage. For individualized quotes on video games contact hello@saltandsagebooks.com. All editor’s letters address visuals, dialogue, and explain historical/situational context; individualizations available upon request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Screenwriting pricing and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Screenwriting edits include half-hour and hour-long TV, and feature film lengths with page-based pricing: Light Edit $4/page ($40 / 10 pages), Medium Edit $7/page ($70 / 10 pages), Deluxe Edit $13/page ($130 / 10 pages). Pitch Pack Edit flat rate $300.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work with specialist editors for screenwriting projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of 'we edit anything with words' / miscellaneous nonfiction
rubrics_metrics.description: We offer support for graphic novels, comics, RPGs, TTRPGs, and cookbooks, and a wide range of nonfiction projects including essays, Works Cited pages and MLA citations, contracts, professional letters, procurements, quotes, technical editing, science fact-checking, field guides, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If it has words, they probably have someone who can help; contact for quote/consult.
